response.sql: SELECT sc.zoneref AS site_code, si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(sc.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans AS sc INNER JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY sc.zoneref, si.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: At least 10 groups exist among matched scans; otherwise the query returns fewer than 10 rows.
